description: Invoke a supported element handler in JavaScript: onPress/onLongPress, onValueChange or onChangeText. This does not reproduce native hit testing, keyboard entry or a physical gesture. Select an exposed element by nativeTag, testID or fuzzy query; inspect the matched target and resulting behavior. value sets a supported toggle or slider, text invokes a text-input handler, and longPress selects onLongPress. Can attempt to scroll an off-screen target into view. If a plain query finds no JS handler, Buoy tries a real touch on a native control with that label (a native tab bar). Use describe_screen for current controls and run_flow for sequences. Needs the app interaction integration. Works on the free tier.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

includeBuoy.description: Let a fuzzy `query` match Buoy's own overlay. Default false — an exact nativeTag/testID always may.

includeHidden.description: Also match elements on screens that are mounted but not showing. Default false.

longPress.description: Invoke the element's onLongPress instead of onPress. Fails with a clear reason if the element has no onLongPress handler.

observe.description: What to return after the action. Default "screen": the current route and what is on screen, so no follow-up describe_screen is needed. "none" skips it.

query.description: Fuzzy match against testID / label / visible text / component name — e.g. "Sign in".

scrollIntoView.description: Attempt to scroll an off-screen target into view. Default true; inspect the action result.

text.description: For a text input: the string to set via onChangeText.

value.description: For a toggle: true/false (omit to flip). For a slider: the numeric value (omit to jump to the far end).

name: tap_element
